Name: Dead Boy Detectives
Author: handwrittenhello
Description:
[size=4]Explore the supernatural side of Pelican Town with ghosts, magic, and creatures from the Netflix show [i]Dead Boy Detectives.

[url=https://ibb.co/V0dfknhS][img]https://i.ibb.co/xKyxr9cj/Microsoft-Game-DVR-Stardew-Valley-1-6-15-running-SMAPI-4-1-10-with-13-mods-VLC-media-player-4-7-2025.png[/img][/url][/i][/size]

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/6cxTXNCj/installation.png[/img][/url]

[list=1]
[*]Ensure you have all dependencies installed (linked above).
[*]Download the latest version of this mod from here or [url=https://github.com/nbeymer99/DeadBoyDetectives_v1.0.1]Github[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods.[/font]
[*]﻿﻿Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/1Gmbkq21/features.png[/img][/url]

Six full NPCs with over a hundred lines of dialogue, four heart events, and friendship perks:
[list]
[*]Charles Rowland
[*]Edwin Payne
[*]Crystal Palace
[*]Niko Sasaki
[*]The Cat King
[*]Monty Finch
[*]Plus two minor NPCs with plans for further development.
[/list]
One new questline: solve the mystery of the ghost in the graveyard with the Dead Boy Detective Agency!

New locations:
[list]
[*]Dead Boy Detective Agency (inside the Community Center)
[*]Point No Point Lighthouse (west of the beach)
[*]Tragic Mick's Magic Tricks (with shop inventory)
[*]Tongue and Tail Butcher Shop (with shop inventory)
[*]Tongue and Tail rented rooms
[*]Charles' Bag of Tricks Backpack
[*]Crystal's Void
[*]Docks (east of the beach)
[*]Imperial Pacific Cannery
[*]Finch House
[*]Shallow Sound Cemetery (east of the railroad)
[/list]
Also one magical crop, one catchable legendary fish, one new farm animal, several items, and several quests--with many more to come!

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/bjR1hcLv/future-updates.png[/img][/url]

I have more plans for this mod than I have time, so enjoy playing this release version while I work on other additions to the mod, such as:
[list]
[*]Roommateable NPCs
[*]Seasonal outfits
[*]Seasonal buildings
[*]Additional locations: the Creeping Forest
[*]Fleshed-out NPCs: Jenny the butcher, Esther Finch
[*]Additional quests: solve mysteries with the agency and discover the secrets of the ghosts of Pelican Town
[*]Continually updating compatibility with popular mods and recolors
[/list]

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/MDHL3VF6/compatibility.png[/img]
[/url]
[size=4][u][b]Other Mods/Expansions[/b][/u][/size]
This mod has compatibility with other mods and expansions such as Stardew Valley Expanded, but I do not guarantee full compatibility. Please report any compatibility issues you may find, and I will do my best to include fixes in future updates. If you are adding this mod to an existing save, it is recommended that you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4715]Reset Terrain Features[/url] if you notice any map weirdness, like trees clipping into buildings.

[b][u][size=4]Recolors [/size][/u][/b]
Compatible with Vibrant Pastoral Recolor and DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor. If you have a recolor you'd like to be supported, you are more than welcome to request it. Support for recolors will be added immediately if you send me edited PNGs to include. You may also create your own recolor support mod as long as Dead Boy Detectives is a dependency. 

[b][u][size=4]Android
[/size][/u][/b]Important note: I have no way to test Android compatibility myself, and cannot guarantee the mod will work as intended, but users are welcome to download it and try it out. I also cannot promise to maintain Android compatibility in the future. Current status: v1.3.0 should work on Android, as long as the Android-specific version of SpaceCore and other dependencies have been installed. 

[list]
[*][b]11/24/2025[/b]: BETAS is now a strict dependency.
[*][s][b]8/7/2025: [/b]BETAS (v3.x.x) is now compatible with Android! Installing BETAS is strongly recommended, and may become a strict dependency again in the future.[/s]
[*][s][b]6/27/2025: [/b]The Android-specific file has been removed. There is no longer any need to download a separate file; the current version (1.2.0) should be compatible on its own. BETAS is also no longer a strict dependency.[/s]
[/list][list]
[*][s][b]5/15/2025: [/b]There is now an Android-compatible file (version 1.0.2) available for download under "optional files". It is the file with "Android" at the end of its name. Dependencies for the Android version are different--BETAS is no longer required, though SMAPI, Content Patcher, and SpaceCore still are (please ensure you're downloading the Android-compatible version of SpaceCore). [/s]
[/list]
